attack_techniques: Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Tools (T1562.001)
attackers_goals: An attacker is attempting to evade detection.
description: A user disabled an Exchange DomainKeys Identified Mail (DKIM) signing configuration. DKIM helps ensure that emails are authorized and not spoofed.
investigative_actions: Follow further actions done by the account. Verify that the configuration change was expected. Check for a possible phishing campaign on the organization.
name: Exchange DKIM signing configuration disabled
